quickref.status: BBR/BBG 2013 captures, the Steam media's 2013 footage and 2026 playtest captures
quickref.look: Mixed effect looks: soft billowing particle fire with dark smoke; painterly cartoon flames (#F47E3E / #FAA751); hard-edged translucent faceted volumes only for specific blasts (nuke dome, radiation burst, shard bursts, white faceted puffs). Pink beams #FF5DFE, cyan lightning #80FFFE. Characters have a thick black ink outline in SkyVu's May 2013 trailer footage (re-used in the Steam trailer and screenshots, the Space Oddity shot and screen_01 included [Inference, strong]; the gameplay matches the 2013 trailer's 160x90 storyboard [Observed, storyboard size]) and in 2026 playtest captures (builds 3.0.0, 3.0.7), but not in the 2012-14 player captures on the wiki [Observed]. Some 2013 fan videos of Graham do have it [Observed: graham.addendum.md, Incidental findings 1].
quickref.firing_and_projectile: Beams are flat ribbons with white-hot cores (pink, thick yellow with concentric muzzle arcs, thin purple); thin yellow tracers.
quickref.impact_end_result: Flat octagonal floor rings (white on Shortest Parsec, white/grey by a Gold Digger tunnel mouth, orange and white over Gold Digger's open pit); pink 4-point star sparks for beam hits, yellow 5-point stars for melee; 2D status icons above heads. The outline is rendered in-game in 2026 [Observed]; whether it is always on or a setting is Unverified.

quickref.status: Seen in the Steam trailer (2013 footage, the 31.7 s Space Oddity shot included); BBR/BBG
quickref.look: Victim goes limp and topples whole, face-down, with no blood. Examples at 12.6 s, 31.7 s, about 40.1 s and 41.1 s in the trailer.
quickref.firing_and_projectile: n/a
quickref.impact_end_result: In one shot the corpse vanished in a single frame about 3 s after the fall, with no fade. Three Joule pickups drop at the death site (since BBG v2.1) [Fan-wiki].

quickref.status: Seen in the Steam trailer (2013 footage); wiki ties it to most Demo explosives
quickref.look: The body breaks into about 4-7 large, clean, toy-like pieces (head, torso and legs, backpack or flag) with no insides visible.
quickref.firing_and_projectile: Observed after a Phat Man blast, an irradiated Huggable bursting, and one B-1000 close-range attack (cyan claw swipe, flash, then the break-up at 4.9 s).
quickref.impact_end_result: Pieces fly up and tumble; on the Huggable they are orange plush with blue stitching plus gold sparkles. What decides break-apart vs intact is Unverified; Tillman's 'pink and red flesh' [Fan-wiki] was not seen.

quickref.status: Rainbow blood in BB-1/BBZ/BB0 [Fan-wiki]; official 2023 merch art; BBG footage
quickref.look: Official merch: headless pink Huggable, white stuffing bursting from the neck, vertical rainbow column [Canon: merch art]. BBG gameplay: plush pieces with gold sparkles. Bite Me jaws smeared rainbow ('Huggable blood').
quickref.firing_and_projectile: n/a
quickref.impact_end_result: Confetti appears in no source. In BBG News shorts a stuffing-plus-rainbow-column KO follows SkyVu's merch, but note that gameplay shows plush chunks.

quickref.status: BBR/BBG; the Steam trailer (2013 footage)
quickref.look: A one-frame flat bright flash on the target (the gold bear turns lemon yellow at 38.3 s); star sparks; green health bar that degrades to red (numbers added later).
quickref.firing_and_projectile: n/a
quickref.impact_end_result: No damage numbers seen. A red '( ! )' bracket reticle appears in Assassin and Engineer views (meaning Unverified). Some characters flicker between two colours (base Unverified).

quickref.status: BBR v1.4.3; nerfed in BBG v2.20
quickref.look: Bone rifle with an animal-head scope [Fan-wiki]
quickref.firing_and_projectile: 'a single, red, stream-like bullet' [Fan-wiki]; the trailer shows a thin pale white zigzag trail, a mismatch, so the identification is Inference.
quickref.impact_end_result: Painterly flames, then a large translucent red horned skull (~#FC2034 to #FE2B35) rises as the whole body topples. A white-lock hit is an instant-kill headshot; a red crosshair shows over the scoped target; the kill feed shows 'HEAD SHOT' with the victim's portrait under a red crosshair. No crit system in BBG [Inference].

quickref.firing_and_projectile: n/a

open_questions: Deaths in the 2026 build: does it keep intact collapses, break-apart deaths and one-frame corpse removal? All appear in the Steam trailer, but that is SkyVu's May 2013 footage [Inference, strong], so it says nothing about the 2026 build. No Next Fest demo is listed on today's Steam page (the only event is 'Final Discord Playtest this Thursday Oct 15'); the JustNubz Closed Playtest #4 showcase, if viewable, or the Nov 4 launch build could confirm.

What decides whether a kill breaks the body apart or leaves it intact? And is the Green Oliver break-up at 4.9 s gameplay, or trailer staging (orange streak background leading into the B-1000 intro card at 5.8 s)?

Ink outline, partly answered: the outline is in SkyVu's May 2013 trailer footage and in 2026 in-game captures (builds 3.0.0 and 3.0.7), but not in the 2012-14 player captures on the wiki [Observed]. Some 2013 fan videos of Graham have it too [Observed: graham.addendum.md]. Was it the 2013 'HD Graphics' mode [Inference]? Is it always on in 2026, or a graphics setting? The 2026 playtest menu thumbnail shows none on the Gear Up model.
Is the white rainbow-dot Huggable flag (cyan Huggable at about 35 s, red Huggable in screen_04; Steam trailer and screenshots, 2013 footage) a skin flag or a change to the team-coloured flag?

Does a BBG Huggable spray rainbow when it dies? SkyVu's 2023 merch art shows a rainbow column and white stuffing; BBG footage shows plush chunks with gold sparkles. The 3.3-3.8 s rainbow fan is most likely Peek A Boo.

What do the Bearzooka's explosion and muzzle flash look like in official and 2026 media (2014-15 fan footage shows a faceted yellow blast with grey smoke)? Is the 1.92-3.05 s trailer rocket really a Bearzooka rocket (Inference, high)? Is it one loaded plus one in reserve (HUD '0/1', '1/1') or two shots, as the body text says?
Do gibbed bears show the 'pink and red flesh' the wiki describes for Tillman?
How do the in-game Frozen state, the poison skull icons, the Combat Tech and Arbiter poison clouds, and the Drain Field in play look? Only concept art and menu renders were found.
Is there a respawn or spawn-in effect, or a death cam? How long do corpses normally stay? One trailer corpse vanished in a single frame about 3 s after death.
What does the green 'OH BABY' HUD text mean? Possibly a killstreak call.

Which weapons made these trailer effects: the pink beams at 8.2 s and 9.1-9.8 s, B-1000's attack at 4.6 s, the red armour chunks already airborne at 26.2 s, the magenta/yellow shard bursts at 30.8-32.2 s, the pink fuzzy head-like object at 8.2-8.4 s, the yellow sky streaks at about 49.6-51.5 s, the orange sky cone with ring shockwaves at 52.5 s, and the purple beam at 40.4 s (Adrenaline Gun?)?
Is the two-state colour flicker on the cyan Huggable and the shield bear a hit flash, a skin effect or something else?
